(o) Consequent to the Hon’ble Supreme Court’s order dated 10.4.2018 in NTPC matters, Petition No. 121/2007 was listed for hearing on 8.1.2019. The Commission vide order dated 18.1.2019 in Petition No. 121/2007, directed the Petitioner to submit its claim separately for the assets at the time of filing of truing up petition for the 2014-19 tariff period in respect of the concerned transmission assets.
